burr: 83 mm flat, swappable espresso and filter burr sets

source.title: Niche Duo product page: espresso 0–10
source.notes: Espresso burr set only; the filter burrs cannot reach espresso.

source.title: Niche Duo product page: French press 45+
source.notes: Niche gives '45+' with no upper limit; 60 is the end of the usable ring.

procedure.en: Niche's published procedure: clean the grinder, fit the funnel hand-tight, rotate the top dial clockwise until the burrs touch, then rotate the black bezel until the silver ball lines up with the 'Calibrate' mark. Turn counter-clockwise to your setting. Never grind at the calibrate position.
procedure.pt-BR: Procedimento publicado pela Niche: limpe o moedor, encaixe o funil apertando com a mão, gire o dial superior no sentido horário até as mós se tocarem e então gire o bezel preto até a bolinha prateada alinhar com a marca 'Calibrate'. Gire no sentido anti-horário até o seu ajuste. Nunca moa na posição de calibração.

notes: Stepless; values are marks from your own calibrated zero. Two swappable 83 mm flat burr sets: the espresso burrs can also do filter, the filter burrs cannot reach espresso. No Honest Coffee Guide page and no micron data. The zero procedure is Niche's calibration article (nichecoffee.co.uk/blogs/exploring-coffee/how-to-calibrate-your-grinder-for-optimum-performance), written for the Niche range.
